project.name: [SANDBOX] Dogfood Large - Reporting Platform Hardening
project.brief: Turn a vague request to harden a reporting platform into research, implementation, QA, dependency sequencing, and closeout work while preserving sync outputs.
principles: Preserve existing report and sync outputs unless explicitly changed.
Use milestones and blockers so future agents can choose safe work.

issues.title: Guide: Agent Operating Guide
issues.description:
## Objective
Define the operating system for a large reporting hardening project.

## Context
The request is intentionally vague and must be decomposed into research, output preservation, implementation, QA, and handoff work.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Original brief is preserved.
- Source-of-truth surfaces are named.
- First safe research and inventory issues are identified.

## Verification
Read back project graph, milestones, ledger, and dependency edges.

## Notes For Future Agents
Do not implement until research and output inventory are complete.

issues.title: Guide: Verification Matrix
issues.description:
## Objective
Define verification gates for reports, sync outputs, data semantics, and release closeout.

## Context
Reporting hardening is unsafe without before/after output preservation checks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Baseline checks are named.
- Output preservation gates are required before data changes.
- Final read-back requirements are explicit.

## Verification
Review matrix against inventory findings and update when discovery changes scope.

## Notes For Future Agents
Treat missing output baselines as a QA / verification gap.

issues.title: Research reporting architecture and source material
issues.description:
## Objective
Map report generation, data sources, schedules, and downstream consumers.

## Context
The project cannot be decomposed safely until source material is known.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Report entry points and source tables are listed.
- Existing docs and repo instructions are linked.
- Unknowns are classified as blockers, candidates, or context-only notes.

## Verification
Produce a research artifact and link it from the ledger.

## Notes For Future Agents
Create new issues immediately for blocking data or sync discoveries.

issues.title: Inventory production gates and sync outputs
issues.description:
## Objective
Inventory deploy, auth, cron, data semantics, and sink/output preservation gates.

## Context
The skill should force output preservation before implementation touches reports or sync paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Current sinks and reports are listed.
- Before/after comparison method is named.
- Missing baselines become QA / verification gap issues.

## Verification
Run `linear-agent inventory --repo <repo>` and record the output.

## Notes For Future Agents
Do not mark data work agent-ready until this issue is complete.

issues.title: Implement data integrity hardening
issues.description:
## Objective
Fix confirmed data integrity risks without changing report semantics.

## Context
Implementation depends on research and output inventory.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Only confirmed data issues are changed.
- Before/after report output comparison is recorded.
- Migration or schema risks are captured.

## Verification
Run data tests and output comparison gates.

## Notes For Future Agents
Create a Decision required issue for ambiguous business semantics.

issues.title: Harden sync and scheduled reporting reliability
issues.description:
## Objective
Address confirmed sync or schedule reliability risks.

## Context
Sync changes can leak into downstream outputs, so gates are mandatory.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Retry/error behavior is verified.
- Sink outputs remain stable unless explicitly accepted.
- Monitoring or runbook updates are linked.

## Verification
Run sync tests, cron dry-run, and output preservation checks.

## Notes For Future Agents
Create a Defect issue for any discovered sink mismatch.

issues.title: Final QA, handoff, and closeout
issues.description:
## Objective
Close the hardening project with evidence future agents can trust.

## Context
Large projects need project-level reconciliation, residual risks, and handoff notes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All blockers are resolved or documented.
- Verification matrix is complete.
- Ledger, issue comments, and dependency links agree.

## Verification
Run final test suite, output preservation comparison, and Linear read-back.

## Notes For Future Agents
Leave follow-up candidates for useful but non-blocking improvements.
